skill_name: Provide an argument why the Internet should remain neutral.
workflow: Net neutrality is essential for ensuring an open and competitive internet. Maintaining a neutral internet allows for a level playing field for individuals, organizations and businesses - it enables them to develop, distribute, and access content on their own terms.
